name: selectpdf
description: Expert skills for the SelectPdf .NET libraries: SelectPdf.Universal (cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon, Docker) and the classic Select.Pdf library for Windows, each with its free Community Edition. HTML to PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint to PDF, PDF to Word, Excel and PowerPoint, PDF creation and editing, merge and split, AcroForms and XFA forms, digital signatures and validation, redaction and sanitizing, encryption, PDF to text/image, accessible tagged PDF/UA and PDF/A with validation and preflight, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X. C# and VB.NET.
